data.description: The sample data: a sample_data artifact id, or the name of a dataset the API serves. Leave out to find the data in the tenant's Cast hooks and bind against their live output

slot.description: Bind one slot of the frame (frame-match's slots): the run works on that slot's nodes only, and ends with bind.done instead of bind.publish

id.description: The slot's id, from frame-match's slots

name.description: Its heading, slugged: the-brave-squad. The data's name defaults to it

nodes.description: The tree node ids the slot owns

signature.description: Its structural signature: what a person's answers about it are kept under

content.description: frame-match's read of whether the slot shows data

readFrom.description: Page keys of other slots' choices it reads on purpose (a designer's note or a person's answer said so)

request.description: What a person asked of this section's data, in comments on its bound preview: each comment's words with the node it is on (`on name (Text, src 1:2): show the surname only`). The run starts from the plan the preview binds now and changes what is asked
